en: I made my way to the castle with weary steps.
ja: 僕は疲れた足どりで、城へ向かった。
answer: I made my way to the castle with weary steps.

en: A soldier led me to the king.
ja: 兵士が僕を王様の元へと案内した。
answer: A soldier led me to the king.

en: The king was sitting on a magnificent chair.
ja: 王様は立派な椅子に座っていた。
answer: The king was sitting on a magnificent chair.

en: "Hero Takashi, you have come at last."
ja: 「勇者タカシよ、よくぞ参った」
answer: "Hero Takashi, you have come at last."

en: "Now then, at the end of this world lives the Demon Lord Dororo."
ja: 「さて、この世界の果てには魔王ドロロがいる」
answer: "Now then, at the end of this world lives the Demon Lord Dororo."

en: I said it firmly, without waiting for the king to finish.
ja: 僕は王様の言葉が終わるのを待たずに力強く言った。
answer: I said it firmly, without waiting for the king to finish.

ja: 王様は困った顔になった。

en: "Wait. Hear me out to the end."
ja: 「待たれよ、最後まで話を聞くのじゃ」
answer: "Wait. Hear me out to the end."

en: "No, thank you! I am not going on a journey."
ja: 「お断りします！僕は旅立ちません」
answer: "No, thank you! I am not going on a journey."
